newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indonesia's BDNI sets US$78 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's BDNI sets US$78 mln FRCD.

text.p: The following issue was announced by the arrangers.
BORROWER PT BANK DAGANG NASIONAL INDONESIA, CAYMAN ISLANDS
BRANCH
AMOUNT US$78 MLN SPLIT INTO TWO-TRANCHES
(A) US$38 MLN (B) US$40 MLN
COUPON 6ML+70 MATURITY 6 YRS
TYPE FRCD ISS PRICE PAR LAUNCHED 18.FEB.97
PUTS YR 3 CALLS NONE REPLIES 2-3 WEEKS
LISTING -- REPAYMENT BULLET DENOMS --
RATING NONE SALE LMTS STANDARD TAX PROV --
NEG PLG -- CRS DEF -- FORCE MAJ --
HOME CTRY INDONESIA GOV LAW ENGLISH PAY DATE --
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
LEAD MANAGERS US$5 MLN+ 45.0BP ALL-IN 85.0
MANAGERS US$3 MLN+ 40.5BP ALL-IN 83.5
CO-MANAGERS US$2 MLN+ 36.0BP ALL-IN 82.0
ARRANGERS BANKGESELLSCHAFT BERLIN GROUP, BZW, INDOVER BANK,
ING BARINGS AND NATWEST MARKETS.
NOTES THE ISSUE HAS BEEN FULLY UNDERWRITTEN BY THE ARRANGERS.
PROCEEDS WILL BE USED TO FINANCE BDNI'S WORKING CAPITAL
AND TO REFINANCE ITS EXISTING DEBT.
GENERAL SYNDICATION IS TARGETED AT BOTH EUROPEAN AND
MIDDLE EASTERN BANKS.
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
